patch_description: This redesign replaces per-destination routing with a modular directed-Steiner broadcast planner. For manageable destination counts it uses subset dynamic programming to find a minimum-cost shared multicast structure rooted at the source, allowing common cloud transit links to be paid for once and reused by all destinations. A scalable greedy shared-tree fallback is included for unusually large destination sets. The final topology is materialized only after the shared network has been selected, keeping path generation separate from optimization and avoiding redundant transfers.
